# Carcavelos Forecast – 20 October 2026

**Light winds and consistent 1.5m waves make today a solid, mellow option.**

**Morning (Sunrise to 11:00):** Your window. Glassy conditions with 5–6km/h NNW winds until 10:00, then a gradual pickup. Swell holding steady at 1.2–1.3m with 12-second periods. Best session: 06:00–09:00 before wind strengthens. Water temp 13.6–14.9°C—gloves recommended.

**Midday Transition (11:00–12:00):** Wind jumps to 15km/h. Expect slight chop, but swell peaks at 1.32m. Still rideable, just less clean.

**Afternoon (12:00–16:00):** Maintains 1.5–1.6m with 15–20km/h NNW winds. Choppier than morning but workable for experienced surfers. Warmest water of the day (18.7°C).

**Tips:** Grab an early session to avoid afternoon chop. Stick with a familiar board—these aren't big waves, so responsiveness matters. Crowd thins by lunchtime if you're after space.
